summary: Terex Corporation filed a routine Form 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on October 16, 2026, disclosing a press release issued October 14, 2026, announcing its third-quarter 2026 earnings conference call for Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time, with results released beforehand. CEO Simon Meester and CFO Jennifer Kong-Picarello will host; the webcast and replay are accessible at investors.terex.com. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics were disclosed. This is an ordinary earnings-scheduling notice, not a special situation; no deal or risk-arb angle exists.
